issues.title: Multi-user demo cleanup needs a conflict check
issues.problem: UPDATE reversal restores the full earlier row using its primary key. It does not check whether another active session has since edited that row.
issues.proposal: Verify two-user edits, logout and expiry on an isolated fixture. Preserve later edits and the audit chain before offering shared demo actions.

issues.title: Competing arrival and learning directories
issues.problem: Home and Launchpad duplicate doors. Guides repeats the journey directory. The tour has 60 stops, and the short list does not have its own next/back sequence.
issues.proposal: Use one arrival flow and one Learn home. Keep guided scenarios and reference material inside it.

issues.title: Selected context is lost
issues.problem: The Earth election card on civic home opened an Anne Arundel election. Named feed and calendar links point to the generic election resolver.
issues.proposal: Carry the selected election, place and work item through links, forms and results.

issues.title: Public discussion, live rooms and testimony overlap
issues.problem: The menu exposes square, halls, live square, live halls and private rooms. They have distinct record/privacy purposes but competing entry points.
issues.proposal: Use one Community directory. Label public record, live meeting and private conversation by purpose; retain their different rules.

issues.title: Lessons cannot support onboarding yet
issues.problem: The election-board lesson shows translation keys as its title and quiz text. Its template starts with a comprehension check without the lesson body.
issues.proposal: Restore readable lesson content, then connect learning to a real exercise and outcome.

issues.title: Meeting and jury controls stop short
issues.problem: The live committee room has incomplete call/vote controls. Enter deliberation room in the juror view has no destination or click handler.
issues.proposal: Complete the selected meeting and case workflows before promoting them as playable scenarios.

issues.title: Economic activities have missing counterparts
issues.problem: Job applications are wired, but employer posting/decision interfaces were not found. Help requests are read-only. Share issuance exists in the engine without a located UI invocation.
issues.proposal: Finish one buyer/seller or employer/applicant round trip. Put agreements and finance inside the relevant person or organization context.

issues.title: Some ordinary pages perform world-scale work
issues.problem: Economy home verifies the full ledger per request. Term Sync loads all active legislatures. Co-determination loads all boards before focus. These were not load-tested.
issues.proposal: Use bounded context, paging and cached progress before widening demo navigation.

issues.title: Host and developer work crowds player navigation
issues.problem: The full menu mixes setup, node operation, developer kits, coverage reports and player activities. Some new operator pages repeat readouts while writes remain in older consoles.
issues.proposal: Give host/developer tools separate entry points. Keep public observation and reference access available.
